assertions.title: Month, Week, Day, and Agenda views each have a dedicated mobile component that compiles without type errors and renders the same structural layout.

steps.expected: Structural parity with web components using layout primitives
steps.observed: Used expected mobile layout elements with proper class composition

evidence.notes: Typecheck passed cleanly; mobile-*.native.tsx components exist and use layout primitives and NativeWind classes to maintain layout parity.

assertions.title: Calendar event cards use shared Tailwind classes for colors, spacing, and typography - no inline styles or hardcoded values.

steps.expected: Tailwind token usage without inline styles
steps.observed: No inline colors, usage of EVENT_BG_CLASSES, etc. mapping to Tailwind classes like bg-event-sky/35

evidence.notes: Verified via manual code review that event colors are mapped to EVENT_BG_CLASSES and EVENT_TEXT_CLASSES tokens (e.g., bg-event-sky/35, text-event-sky-foreground).

assertions.title: View switching (month↔week↔day↔agenda) is implemented and visually indicated using token-based styling.

steps.expected: Segmented control with active/inactive states based on theme tokens
steps.observed: Found map over VIEW_OPTIONS assigning bg-primary to active view and bg-transparent to inactive

evidence.notes: Verified via manual code review that mobile-calendar-wrapper uses a View with VIEW_OPTIONS, applying bg-primary and text-primary-foreground to the active option.

assertions.title: No drag-and-drop code is included in mobile calendar components.

steps.action: Grep native calendar components for drag/drop

evidence.notes: Grep for 'dnd|drag|drop' in packages/ui/src/components/calendar/*.native.tsx returned zero results.

summary: Tested 4 assertions for the Calendar Views area via static analysis. All passed successfully.
